name: Elementary Down-Shift
definition: For a Boolean class $H\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$ and $x\in X$, let $P_x(H)=H_x^0\cup H_x^1$ and $I_x(H)=H_x^0\cap H_x^1$. The elementary down-shift $D_xH$ has lower $x$-section $P_x(H)$ and upper $x$-section $I_x(H)$. Equivalently, an unmatched upper concept moves to its lower mate while matched pairs remain.
comments: Down-shifting preserves cardinality and the active ground set may shrink if the two resulting sections coincide. Iterated shifts are also called down-compressions.
